import terms = "./terms.qui"

class Clause(int head, int body, string filename, int line)
class Predicate(string name, int arity, Clause[] clauses := [])
class Database()
    Predicate[] predicates := []

int find(const Database database, string name, int arity)
    for: index < int(#database.predicates)
        if database.predicates[index].name == name and database.predicates[index].arity == arity
            return index
    return -1

int goal_predicate(const Database database, const terms.Store store, int goal)
    index := terms.dereference(store, goal)
    return find(database, store.nodes[index].name, terms.arity(store, index))

int add(Database &database, const terms.Store store, Clause clause)
    index := goal_predicate(database, store, clause.head)
    if index < 0
        head := terms.dereference(store, clause.head)
        index = int(#database.predicates)
        database.predicates = database.predicates.append(Predicate(store.nodes[head].name, terms.arity(store, head)))
    database.predicates[index].clauses = database.predicates[index].clauses.append(clause)
    return index

int[] candidates(const Database database, const terms.Store store, int predicate, int goal)
    definition := database.predicates[predicate]
    int[] result := []
    index := terms.dereference(store, goal)
    for: clause < int(#definition.clauses)
        if definition.arity == 0
            result = result.append(clause)
        else
            head := terms.dereference(store, definition.clauses[clause].head)
            if terms.same_kind(store, store.nodes[index].args[0], store.nodes[head].args[0])
                result = result.append(clause)
    return result

Clause copy_clause(terms.Store &store, Clause clause)
    values := terms.copy_terms(&store, [clause.head, clause.body])
    return Clause(values[0], values[1], clause.filename, clause.line)

import terms = "./terms.qui"
import reader = "./reader.qui"
import unify = "./unify.qui"
import database = "./database.qui"
import predicates = "./predicates.qui"

bool control(string name, int arity)
    return (name == "," and arity == 2) or (name == "!" and arity == 0) or (name == ";" and arity == 2) or (name == "->" and arity == 2) or (name == "\+" and arity == 1) or (name == "catch" and arity == 3) or (name == "call" and arity >= 1 and arity <= 8)

bool builtin(string name, int arity)
    return predicates.deterministic(name, arity) or (name == "findall" and arity == 3) or (name == "throw" and arity == 1) or (name == "between" and arity == 3) or (name == "length" and arity == 2)

int goal_conversion(terms.Store &store, int term);

int goal_conversion(terms.Store &store, int term)
    index := terms.dereference(store, term)
    terms.Node source := store.nodes[index]
    if source.kind == "variable"
        return terms.compound(&store, "call", [index])
    if source.kind == "integer"
        return -1
    if source.kind == "compound" and #source.args == 2 and (source.name == "," or source.name == ";" or source.name == "->")
        left := goal_conversion(&store, source.args[0])
        if left < 0
            return -1
        right := goal_conversion(&store, source.args[1])
        if right < 0
            return -1
        return terms.compound(&store, source.name, [left, right])
    return index

string atom_name(string name, bool quoted)
    word := #name > 0 and reader.lowercase(name[0])
    symbolic := #name > 0 and name != "."
    for: position < int(#name)
        word = word and reader.alphanumeric(name[position])
        symbolic = symbolic and reader.symbols.contains(name[position])
    if not quoted or word or symbolic or name == "[]" or name == "!" or name == ";"
        return name
    result := "'"
    for: position < int(#name)
        character := name[position]
        if character == "\"
            result += "\\"
        elif character == "'"
            result += "\'"
        elif character == NL
            result += "\n"
        elif character == HT
            result += "\t"
        else
            result += character
    return result + "'"

class Writer(quoted := true)
    names := map<int, string>()
    next_name := 1

string write_term(Writer &writer, const terms.Store store, int term, limit := 1200, operand := false);

string write_term(Writer &writer, const terms.Store store, int term, int limit, bool operand)
    index := terms.dereference(store, term)
    terms.Node node := store.nodes[index]
    if node.kind == "variable"
        match writer.names.get(index)
            string existing
                return existing
            none
                name := "_G{writer.next_name}"
                writer.next_name += 1
                .writer.names.set(index, name)
                return name
    if node.kind == "integer"
        return string(node.value)
    if node.kind == "atom"
        text := atom_name(node.name, writer.quoted)
        return if operand and (reader.operation(node.name).priority > 0 or reader.prefix_priority(node.name) > 0) then "({text})" else text
    if node.name == "." and #node.args == 2
        parts := terms.list_parts(store, index)
        string[] elements := []
        for element := parts.elements[]
            elements = elements.append(write_term(&writer, store, element, 999))
        result := "[" + elements.join(",")
        if not terms.is_atom(store, parts.tail, "[]")
            result += "|" + write_term(&writer, store, parts.tail, 999)
        return result + "]"
    op := reader.operation(node.name)
    if #node.args == 2 and op.priority > 0
        left := write_term(&writer, store, node.args[0], op.left, true)
        right := write_term(&writer, store, node.args[1], op.right, true)
        text := ""
        if node.name == ","
            text = left + "," + right
        elif reader.lowercase(node.name[0])
            text = left + " " + node.name + " " + right
        else
            before := if #left > 0 and reader.symbols.contains(left[int(#left) - 1]) then " " else ""
            after := if #right > 0 and reader.symbols.contains(right[0]) then " " else ""
            text = left + before + node.name + after + right
        return if op.priority > limit then "({text})" else text
    priority := reader.prefix_priority(node.name)
    if #node.args == 1 and priority > 0
        argument := write_term(&writer, store, node.args[0], priority, true)
        space := #argument > 0 and (reader.symbols.contains(argument[0]) or reader.digit(argument[0]) or argument[0] == "(")
        text := node.name + (if space then " " else "") + argument
        return if priority > limit then "({text})" else text
    string[] args := []
    for argument := node.args[]
        args = args.append(write_term(&writer, store, argument, 999))
    return atom_name(node.name, writer.quoted) + "(" + args.join(",") + ")"

string written(const terms.Store store, int term, quoted := true)
    writer := Writer(quoted)
    return write_term(&writer, store, term)

string predicate_name(terms.Store &store, string name, int arity)
    term := terms.indicator_term(&store, name, arity)
    return written(store, term)

string goal_name(terms.Store &store, int goal)
    index := terms.dereference(store, goal)
    string name := store.nodes[index].name
    arity := terms.arity(store, index)
    return predicate_name(&store, name, arity)

class Consultant()
    db := database.Database()
    string[] reports := []
    int[][] counts := [[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]
    last := [-1, -1]
    discontiguous := distinct<(int, int)>()

string source_name(int source_index)
    return if source_index == 0 then "prelude.pl" else "program.pl"

void warning(Consultant &consultant, int source_index, int line, string message)
    consultant.reports = consultant.reports.append("{source_name(source_index)}:{line}: warning: {message}")
    consultant.counts[source_index][2] += 1

bool has_source(const database.Predicate predicate, string filename)
    for clause := predicate.clauses[]
        if clause.filename == filename
            return true
    return false

void add_clause(Consultant &consultant, terms.Store &store, int term, int source_index, int line, const reader.ReadState syntax)
    filename := source_name(source_index)
    head := term
    body := -1
    if terms.indicator(store, term, ":-", 2)
        head = store.nodes[term].args[0]
        body = store.nodes[term].args[1]
    fault := -1
    kind := terms.kind(store, head)
    if kind == "variable"
        fault = terms.atom(&store, "instantiation_error")
    elif kind == "integer"
        fault = terms.type_error(&store, "callable", head)
    elif control(store.nodes[head].name, terms.arity(store, head)) or builtin(store.nodes[head].name, terms.arity(store, head))
        modify := terms.atom(&store, "modify")
        static_procedure := terms.atom(&store, "static_procedure")
        indicator := terms.term_indicator(&store, head)
        fault = terms.compound(&store, "permission_error", [modify, static_procedure, indicator])
    elif body >= 0
        converted := goal_conversion(&store, body)
        if converted < 0
            fault = terms.type_error(&store, "callable", body)
        else
            body = converted
    if fault >= 0
        consultant.reports = consultant.reports.append("{filename}:{line}: error: " + written(store, fault))
        consultant.counts[source_index][1] += 1
        return
    predicate := database.goal_predicate(consultant.db, store, head)
    if predicate >= 0
        if source_index == 1 and has_source(consultant.db.predicates[predicate], "prelude.pl")
            warning(&consultant, source_index, line, "redefining prelude procedure " + goal_name(&store, head))
            consultant.db.predicates[predicate].clauses = []
        if has_source(consultant.db.predicates[predicate], filename) and consultant.last[source_index] != predicate and not consultant.discontiguous.has((source_index, predicate))
            warning(&consultant, source_index, line, "clauses of " + goal_name(&store, head) + " are not together")
            .consultant.discontiguous.add((source_index, predicate))
    predicate = database.add(&consultant.db, store, database.Clause(head, body, filename, line))
    consultant.last[source_index] = predicate
    consultant.counts[source_index][0] += 1
    string[] singletons := []
    string[] repeated := []
    for name := syntax.counts.keys()[]
        count := 0
        match syntax.counts.get(name)
            int found
                count = found
            none
                count = 0
        if name[0] != "_" and count == 1
            singletons = singletons.append(name)
        if #name > 1 and name[0] == "_" and count > 1
            repeated = repeated.append(name)
    if #singletons > 0
        warning(&consultant, source_index, line, "singleton variables: " + singletons.join(", "))
    if #repeated > 0
        warning(&consultant, source_index, line, "variables starting with _ occur more than once: " + repeated.join(", "))

string[] read_lines(string path)
    input := file.read(path)
    string[] result := []
    while .input(string &line)
        result = result.append(line)
    return result

void consult(Consultant &consultant, terms.Store &store, int source_index)
    filename := source_name(source_index)
    lines := read_lines("input/" + filename)
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    state := reader.ReadState(reader.tokenize(text))
    while reader.peek(state).kind != "eof"
        line := reader.peek(state).line
        term := reader.clause(&state, &store)
        if state.error_index >= 0
            reader.Token token := state.tokens[state.error_index]
            consultant.counts[source_index][1] += 1
            consultant.reports = consultant.reports.append("{filename}:{token.line}:{token.column}: syntax error: {state.message}")
            if token.kind != "eof"
                consultant.reports = consultant.reports.append("    " + lines[token.line - 1])
                consultant.reports = consultant.reports.append(" " * nat(token.column + 3) + "^")
            state.position = state.error_index
            while reader.peek(state).kind != "end" and reader.peek(state).kind != "eof"
                reader.take(&state)
            if reader.peek(state).kind == "end"
                reader.take(&state)
        else
            add_clause(&consultant, &store, term, source_index, line, state)

void finish_consult(Consultant &consultant, terms.Store &store)
    distinct<string> reported
    for predicate := consultant.db.predicates[]
        for clause := predicate.clauses[]
            int[] pending := if clause.body < 0 then [] else [clause.body]
            while #pending != 0
                term := terms.dereference(store, pending[-1])
                pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
                terms.Node node := store.nodes[term]
                if node.kind == "variable" or node.kind == "integer"
                    continue
                arity := terms.arity(store, term)
                if arity == 2 and (node.name == "," or node.name == ";" or node.name == "->")
                    pending = pending.append(node.args[1]).append(node.args[0])
                elif arity == 1 and (node.name == "\+" or node.name == "call")
                    pending = pending.append(node.args[0])
                elif node.name == "findall" and arity == 3
                    pending = pending.append(node.args[1])
                elif node.name == "catch" and arity == 3
                    pending = pending.append(node.args[2]).append(node.args[0])
                elif not control(node.name, arity) and not builtin(node.name, arity) and database.find(consultant.db, node.name, arity) < 0 and not reported.has(terms.key(store, term))
                    .reported.add(terms.key(store, term))
                    source_index := if clause.filename == "prelude.pl" then 0 else 1
                    target := predicate_name(&store, node.name, arity)
                    caller := predicate_name(&store, predicate.name, predicate.arity)
                    warning(&consultant, source_index, clause.line, "undefined procedure {target} called from {caller}")
    for: source_index < 2
        counts := consultant.counts[source_index]
        consultant.reports = consultant.reports.append("{source_name(source_index)}: clauses={counts[0]} errors={counts[1]} warnings={counts[2]}")
    clauses := 0
    for predicate := consultant.db.predicates[]
        clauses += int(#predicate.clauses)
    consultant.reports = consultant.reports.append("database: predicates={#consultant.db.predicates} clauses={clauses}")

string[] listing(const database.Database db, const terms.Store store)
    string[] lines := []
    alphabet := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    for predicate := db.predicates[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        for clause := predicate.clauses[]
            variables := terms.variables_in(store, [clause.head, clause.body])
            map<int, int> counts
            for variable := variables[]
                .counts.increment(variable)
            writer := Writer()
            serial := 0
            for variable := variables[]
                if writer.names.has(variable)
                    continue
                count := 0
                match counts.get(variable)
                    int found
                        count = found
                    none
                        count = 0
                if count == 1
                    .writer.names.set(variable, "_")
                else
                    suffix := if serial < 26 then "" else string(serial / 26)
                    .writer.names.set(variable, alphabet[serial % 26] + suffix)
                    serial += 1
            head := write_term(&writer, store, clause.head)
            if clause.body < 0
                lines = lines.append(head + ".")
                continue
            lines = lines.append(head + " :-")
            int[] goals := []
            int body := clause.body
            while terms.indicator(store, body, ",", 2)
                goals = goals.append(store.nodes[body].args[0])
                body = store.nodes[body].args[1]
            goals = goals.append(body)
            for: index < int(#goals)
                ending := if index + 1 == int(#goals) then "." else ","
                lines = lines.append("    " + write_term(&writer, store, goals[index], 999) + ending)
    return lines

class QueryVariable(string name, int term)

string answer(const terms.Store store, const QueryVariable[] variables)
    writer := Writer()
    for variable := variables[]
        value := terms.dereference(store, variable.term)
        if terms.kind(store, value) == "variable" and not writer.names.has(value)
            .writer.names.set(value, variable.name)
    map<int, string> previous
    string[] items := []
    for variable := variables[]
        value := terms.dereference(store, variable.term)
        if terms.kind(store, value) == "variable"
            match previous.get(value)
                string earlier
                    items = items.append("{earlier} = {variable.name}")
                    .previous.set(value, variable.name)
                none
                    .previous.set(value, variable.name)
        else
            items = items.append(variable.name + " = " + write_term(&writer, store, value, 699, true))
    return if #items == 0 then "true" else items.join(", ")

class Entry(goal := -1, barrier := 0, context := -1, marker := "", payload := -1)
class GoalNode(Entry entry, int next)
class Choice(string kind, int mark, int resume)
    barrier := 0
    context := -1
    parent := -1
    goal := -1
    predicate := -1
    int[] candidates := []
    next_candidate := 0
    catcher := -1
    recovery := -1
    template := -1
    result := -1
    int[] results := []
    target := -1
    tail := -1
    number := -1
    upper := 0
    next := 0
    count := 0

class Profile(string name, int arity, calls := 0, tries := 0)
class Profiles()
    Profile[] rows := []

int profile_index(Profiles &profiles, string name, int arity)
    for: index < int(#profiles.rows)
        if profiles.rows[index].name == name and profiles.rows[index].arity == arity
            return index
    index := int(#profiles.rows)
    profiles.rows = profiles.rows.append(Profile(name, arity))
    return index

class Engine(QueryVariable[] variables, int limit)
    trail := unify.Trail()
    GoalNode[] goal_nodes := []
    goals := -1
    Choice[] choices := []
    int[] stack := []
    context := -1
    current_name := ""
    current_arity := 0
    solutions := 0
    inferences := 0
    choicepoints := 0
    backtracks := 0
    string[] answers := []
    output := ""
    ball := -1
    limit_exceeded := false

int prepend(Engine &engine, int continuation, Entry[] entries)
    result := continuation
    position := int(#entries) - 1
    while position >= 0
        index := int(#engine.goal_nodes)
        engine.goal_nodes = engine.goal_nodes.append(GoalNode(entries[position], result))
        result = index
        position -= 1
    return result

int create_choice(Engine &engine, string kind, int resume)
    index := int(#engine.choices)
    engine.choices = engine.choices.append(Choice(kind, int(#engine.trail.bindings), resume))
    engine.stack = engine.stack.append(index)
    engine.choicepoints += 1
    return index

void cut(Engine &engine, int height)
    if height < int(#engine.stack)
        engine.stack = engine.stack[0:<height]

bool infer(Engine &engine, Profiles &profiles, string name, int arity)
    if engine.inferences == 20000
        engine.limit_exceeded = true
        return false
    engine.inferences += 1
    index := profile_index(&profiles, name, arity)
    profiles.rows[index].calls += 1
    return true

void fault(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, int detail)
    indicator := terms.indicator_term(&store, engine.current_name, engine.current_arity)
    engine.ball = terms.compound(&store, "error", [detail, indicator])

bool try_clause(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, Profiles &profiles, const database.Database db, int predicate, int candidate, int goal, int barrier, int context, int continuation)
    database.Predicate definition := db.predicates[predicate]
    profile := profile_index(&profiles, definition.name, definition.arity)
    profiles.rows[profile].tries += 1
    clause := database.copy_clause(&store, definition.clauses[candidate])
    if not unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, clause.head, goal)
        return false
    engine.goals = if clause.body < 0 then continuation else prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(clause.body, barrier, context)])
    return true

bool user_call(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, Profiles &profiles, const database.Database db, int goal, int context)
    predicate := database.goal_predicate(db, store, goal)
    if predicate < 0
        procedure := terms.atom(&store, "procedure")
        indicator := terms.term_indicator(&store, goal)
        missing := terms.compound(&store, "existence_error", [procedure, indicator])
        fault(&engine, &store, missing)
        return false
    candidates := database.candidates(db, store, predicate, goal)
    if #candidates == 0
        return false
    height := int(#engine.stack)
    if #candidates > 1
        index := create_choice(&engine, "CLAUSES", engine.goals)
        engine.choices[index].goal = goal
        engine.choices[index].predicate = predicate
        engine.choices[index].candidates = candidates
        engine.choices[index].next_candidate = 1
        engine.choices[index].barrier = height
        engine.choices[index].context = context
    return try_clause(&engine, &store, &profiles, db, predicate, candidates[0], goal, height, context, engine.goals)

bool control_goal(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, int goal, int barrier, int context)
    terms.Node node := store.nodes[goal]
    args := node.args
    continuation := engine.goals
    height := int(#engine.stack)
    if node.name == ","
        engine.goals = prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(args[0], barrier, context), Entry(args[1], barrier, context)])
    elif node.name == "!"
        cut(&engine, barrier)
    elif node.name == ";"
        resume := prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(args[1], barrier, context)])
        create_choice(&engine, "ALT", resume)
        left := terms.dereference(store, args[0])
        if terms.indicator(store, left, "->", 2)
            int[] condition := store.nodes[left].args
            engine.goals = prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(condition[0], height + 1, context), Entry(barrier = barrier, context = context, marker = "ITE", payload = height), Entry(condition[1], barrier, context)])
        else
            engine.goals = prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(left, barrier, context)])
    elif node.name == "->"
        engine.goals = prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(args[0], height, context), Entry(barrier = barrier, context = context, marker = "ITE", payload = height), Entry(args[1], barrier, context)])
    elif node.name == "\+"
        create_choice(&engine, "ALT", continuation)
        call := terms.compound(&store, "call", [args[0]])
        engine.goals = prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(call, barrier, context), Entry(barrier = barrier, context = context, marker = "NAF", payload = height)])
    elif node.name == "call"
        target := terms.dereference(store, args[0])
        kind := terms.kind(store, target)
        if kind == "variable"
            detail := terms.atom(&store, "instantiation_error")
            fault(&engine, &store, detail)
            return false
        if kind == "integer"
            detail := terms.type_error(&store, "callable", target)
            fault(&engine, &store, detail)
            return false
        if #args > 1
            terms.Node original := store.nodes[target]
            int[] parameters := original.args.concat(args[1:<int(#args)])
            target = terms.compound(&store, original.name, parameters)
        converted := goal_conversion(&store, target)
        if converted < 0
            detail := terms.type_error(&store, "callable", target)
            fault(&engine, &store, detail)
            return false
        engine.goals = prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(converted, height, context)])
    elif node.name == "catch"
        frame := create_choice(&engine, "CATCH", continuation)
        engine.choices[frame].catcher = args[1]
        engine.choices[frame].recovery = args[2]
        engine.choices[frame].parent = context
        call := terms.compound(&store, "call", [args[0]])
        engine.goals = prepend(&engine, continuation, [Entry(call, barrier, frame), Entry(barrier = barrier, context = context, marker = "EXIT", payload = frame)])
    return true

bool execute_marker(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, Entry entry)
    if entry.marker == "ITE" or entry.marker == "NAF"
        cut(&engine, entry.payload)
        return entry.marker == "ITE"
    if entry.marker == "EXIT"
        if #engine.stack > 0 and engine.stack[-1] == entry.payload
            engine.stack = engine.stack[0:<int(#engine.stack) - 1]
        return true
    template := engine.choices[entry.payload].template
    copy := terms.copy_term(&store, template)
    engine.choices[entry.payload].results = engine.choices[entry.payload].results.append(copy)
    return false

bool between(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, int[] args)
    lower := predicates.require_integer(&store, args[0])
    if lower.fault >= 0
        fault(&engine, &store, lower.fault)
        return false
    upper := predicates.require_integer(&store, args[1])
    if upper.fault >= 0
        fault(&engine, &store, upper.fault)
        return false
    value := terms.dereference(store, args[2])
    terms.Node target := store.nodes[value]
    if target.kind != "variable" and target.kind != "integer"
        detail := terms.type_error(&store, "integer", value)
        fault(&engine, &store, detail)
        return false
    if target.kind == "integer"
        return lower.value <= target.value and target.value <= upper.value
    if lower.value > upper.value
        return false
    if lower.value < upper.value
        index := create_choice(&engine, "BETWEEN", engine.goals)
        engine.choices[index].upper = upper.value
        engine.choices[index].target = value
        engine.choices[index].next = lower.value + 1
    number := terms.integer(&store, lower.value)
    return unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, value, number)

bool length_goal(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, int[] args)
    number := terms.dereference(store, args[1])
    terms.Node n := store.nodes[number]
    if n.kind != "variable" and n.kind != "integer"
        detail := terms.type_error(&store, "integer", number)
        fault(&engine, &store, detail)
        return false
    if n.kind == "integer" and n.value < 0
        detail := terms.domain_error(&store, "not_less_than_zero", number)
        fault(&engine, &store, detail)
        return false
    parts := terms.list_parts(store, args[0])
    count := int(#parts.elements)
    if terms.is_atom(store, parts.tail, "[]")
        value := terms.integer(&store, count)
        return unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, number, value)
    if terms.kind(store, parts.tail) != "variable"
        detail := terms.type_error(&store, "list", args[0])
        fault(&engine, &store, detail)
        return false
    if n.kind == "integer"
        if n.value < count
            return false
        sequence := terms.fresh_list(&store, n.value - count)
        return unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, parts.tail, sequence)
    frame := create_choice(&engine, "LENGTH", engine.goals)
    engine.choices[frame].tail = parts.tail
    engine.choices[frame].number = number
    engine.choices[frame].count = count
    engine.choices[frame].next = count + 1
    empty := terms.atom(&store, "[]")
    value := terms.integer(&store, count)
    return unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, parts.tail, empty) and unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, number, value)

bool execute_step(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, Profiles &profiles, const database.Database db)
    first := engine.goal_nodes[engine.goals]
    engine.goals = first.next
    entry := first.entry
    engine.context = entry.context
    if #entry.marker > 0
        return execute_marker(&engine, &store, entry)
    goal := terms.dereference(store, entry.goal)
    terms.Node node := store.nodes[goal]
    arity := terms.arity(store, goal)
    engine.current_name = node.name
    engine.current_arity = arity
    if control(node.name, arity)
        return control_goal(&engine, &store, goal, entry.barrier, entry.context)
    if not infer(&engine, &profiles, node.name, arity)
        return false
    if node.name == "findall" and arity == 3
        frame := create_choice(&engine, "FINDALL", engine.goals)
        engine.choices[frame].template = node.args[0]
        engine.choices[frame].result = node.args[2]
        call := terms.compound(&store, "call", [node.args[1]])
        engine.goals = prepend(&engine, -1, [Entry(call, entry.barrier, entry.context), Entry(barrier = entry.barrier, context = entry.context, marker = "COLLECT", payload = frame)])
        return true
    if node.name == "throw" and arity == 1
        ball := terms.dereference(store, node.args[0])
        if terms.kind(store, ball) == "variable"
            detail := terms.atom(&store, "instantiation_error")
            fault(&engine, &store, detail)
        else
            engine.ball = ball
        return false
    if node.name == "between" and arity == 3
        return between(&engine, &store, node.args)
    if node.name == "length" and arity == 2
        return length_goal(&engine, &store, node.args)
    if (node.name == "write" or node.name == "writeq") and arity == 1
        engine.output += written(store, node.args[0], node.name == "writeq")
        return true
    if node.name == "nl" and arity == 0
        engine.output += NL
        return true
    if predicates.deterministic(node.name, arity)
        result := predicates.execute(&store, &engine.trail, goal)
        if result.fault >= 0
            fault(&engine, &store, result.fault)
        return result.success
    return user_call(&engine, &store, &profiles, db, goal, entry.context)

bool backtrack(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, Profiles &profiles, const database.Database db)
    while true
        engine.backtracks += 1
        while #engine.stack != 0
            top := engine.stack[-1]
            unify.undo(&store, &engine.trail, engine.choices[top].mark)
            if engine.choices[top].kind != "CATCH"
                break
            engine.stack = engine.stack[0:<int(#engine.stack) - 1]
        if #engine.stack == 0
            return false
        index := engine.stack[-1]
        choice := engine.choices[index]
        if choice.kind == "ALT"
            engine.stack = engine.stack[0:<int(#engine.stack) - 1]
            engine.goals = choice.resume
            return true
        if choice.kind == "CLAUSES"
            candidate := choice.candidates[choice.next_candidate]
            if choice.next_candidate + 1 == int(#choice.candidates)
                engine.stack = engine.stack[0:<int(#engine.stack) - 1]
            else
                engine.choices[index].next_candidate += 1
            if try_clause(&engine, &store, &profiles, db, choice.predicate, candidate, choice.goal, choice.barrier, choice.context, choice.resume)
                return true
        elif choice.kind == "BETWEEN"
            if not infer(&engine, &profiles, "between", 3)
                return false
            value := choice.next
            if value == choice.upper
                engine.stack = engine.stack[0:<int(#engine.stack) - 1]
            else
                engine.choices[index].next += 1
            term := terms.integer(&store, value)
            if unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, choice.target, term)
                engine.goals = choice.resume
                return true
        elif choice.kind == "LENGTH"
            if not infer(&engine, &profiles, "length", 2)
                return false
            count := choice.next
            engine.choices[index].next += 1
            sequence := terms.fresh_list(&store, count - choice.count)
            number := terms.integer(&store, count)
            if unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, choice.tail, sequence) and unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, choice.number, number)
                engine.goals = choice.resume
                return true
        elif choice.kind == "FINDALL"
            engine.stack = engine.stack[0:<int(#engine.stack) - 1]
            result := terms.make_list(&store, choice.results)
            if unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, result, choice.result)
                engine.goals = choice.resume
                return true
    return false

bool handle_exception(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store)
    ball := terms.copy_term(&store, engine.ball)
    engine.ball = -1
    context := engine.context
    while context >= 0
        frame := engine.choices[context]
        position := 0
        while engine.stack[position] != context
            position += 1
        engine.stack = engine.stack[0:<position]
        unify.undo(&store, &engine.trail, frame.mark)
        mark := int(#engine.trail.bindings)
        copy := terms.copy_term(&store, ball)
        if unify.unify(&store, &engine.trail, copy, frame.catcher)
            call := terms.compound(&store, "call", [frame.recovery])
            engine.goals = prepend(&engine, frame.resume, [Entry(call, int(#engine.stack), frame.parent)])
            return true
        unify.undo(&store, &engine.trail, mark)
        context = frame.parent
    engine.answers = engine.answers.append("uncaught exception: " + written(store, ball))
    return false

int[] execute_query(Engine &engine, terms.Store &store, Profiles &profiles, const database.Database db, int query)
    call := terms.compound(&store, "call", [query])
    engine.goals = prepend(&engine, -1, [Entry(call)])
    while true
        success := false
        if engine.goals < 0
            engine.solutions += 1
            text := answer(store, engine.variables)
            if (engine.limit > 0 and engine.solutions == engine.limit) or #engine.stack == 0
                engine.answers = engine.answers.append(text + ".")
                break
            engine.answers = engine.answers.append(text + " ;")
            success = backtrack(&engine, &store, &profiles, db)
        else
            success = execute_step(&engine, &store, &profiles, db)
            if not success and engine.ball < 0 and not engine.limit_exceeded
                success = backtrack(&engine, &store, &profiles, db)
        if engine.limit_exceeded
            engine.answers = engine.answers.append("inference limit exceeded")
            break
        if engine.ball >= 0
            if handle_exception(&engine, &store)
                continue
            break
        if not success
            engine.answers = engine.answers.append("false.")
            break
    return [engine.solutions, engine.inferences, engine.choicepoints, engine.backtracks]

string statistics(string prefix, int[] counts)
    return "{prefix} solutions={counts[0]} inferences={counts[1]} choicepoints={counts[2]} backtracks={counts[3]}"

void write_lines(string filename, string[] lines)
    output := file.write("output/" + filename)
    if #lines > 0
        .output(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run()
    store := terms.Store()
    consultant := Consultant()
    consult(&consultant, &store, 0)
    consult(&consultant, &store, 1)
    finish_consult(&consultant, &store)
    string[] answers := []
    writes := ""
    string[] stats := []
    profiles := Profiles()
    totals := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    queries := read_lines("input/queries.txt")
    for: index < int(#queries)
        number := index + 1
        source := queries[index]
        answers = answers.append(source)
        writes += "== query {number} =={NL}"
        marker := 0
        match source.find("?- ")
            nat position
                marker = int(position)
            none
                marker = 0
        int limit := if marker == 0 then 0 else int(source[0:<marker].trim())
        start := marker + 3
        syntax := reader.ReadState(reader.tokenize(source[start:<int(#source)], start + 1))
        query := reader.clause(&syntax, &store, true)
        if syntax.error_index >= 0
            reader.Token token := syntax.tokens[syntax.error_index]
            answers = answers.append("syntax error at column {token.column}: {syntax.message}")
            stats = stats.append("query {number}: syntax error")
            continue
        QueryVariable[] variables := []
        for name := syntax.names.keys()[]
            if name[0] == "_"
                continue
            match syntax.names.get(name)
                int term
                    variables = variables.append(QueryVariable(name, term))
                none
                    continue
        engine := Engine(variables, limit)
        counts := execute_query(&engine, &store, &profiles, consultant.db, query)
        totals += counts
        answers = answers.concat(engine.answers)
        writes += engine.output
        if #engine.output > 0 and not engine.output.ends_with(NL)
            writes += NL
        stats = stats.append(statistics("query {number}:", counts))
    stats = stats.append(statistics("total:", totals)).append("== profile ==")
    int[] order := []
    string[] names := []
    int[] negatives := []
    for: index < int(#profiles.rows)
        profile := profiles.rows[index]
        names = names.append(predicate_name(&store, profile.name, profile.arity))
        negatives = negatives.append(-profile.calls)
        order = order.append(index)
    order = order.sorted(by = (negatives, names))
    for index := order[]
        profile := profiles.rows[index]
        if profile.calls == 0
            continue
        text := "{names[index]} calls={profile.calls}"
        if database.find(consultant.db, profile.name, profile.arity) >= 0
            text += " tries={profile.tries}"
        stats = stats.append(text)
    write_lines("consult.txt", consultant.reports)
    write_lines("listing.txt", listing(consultant.db, store))
    write_lines("answers.txt", answers)
    write_lines("stats.txt", stats)
    output := file.write("output/write_output.txt")
    .output(writes)

run()

import terms = "./terms.qui"

const symbols := "+-*/\^<>=~:.?@#&$"
class Operator(int priority, int left, int right)

Operator operation(string name)
    if name == ":-"
        return Operator(1200, 1199, 1199)
    if name == ";"
        return Operator(1100, 1099, 1100)
    if name == "->"
        return Operator(1050, 1049, 1050)
    if name == ","
        return Operator(1000, 999, 1000)
    for item := ["=", "\=", "==", "\==", "is", "=:=", "=\=", "<", ">", "=<", ">=", "=.."][]
        if name == item
            return Operator(700, 699, 699)
    if name == "+" or name == "-"
        return Operator(500, 500, 499)
    for item := ["*", "/", "//", "mod", "rem"][]
        if name == item
            return Operator(400, 400, 399)
    return Operator(0, 0, 0)

int prefix_priority(string name)
    return if name == "\+" then 900 elif name == "-" then 200 else 0

bool lowercase(string character)
    return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(character)

bool uppercase(string character)
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(character)

bool digit(string character)
    return "0123456789".contains(character)

bool alphanumeric(string character)
    return lowercase(character) or uppercase(character) or digit(character) or character == "_"

class Token(string kind, string value, string spelling, int line, int column, bool space, number := 0)
class ReadState(Token[] tokens)
    position := 0
    error_index := -1
    message := ""
    names := map<string, int>()
    counts := map<string, int>()

Token[] tokenize(string text, column := 1)
    Token[] result := []
    position := 0
    line := 1
    col := column
    space := true
    while position < int(#text)
        character := text[position]
        if character == " " or character == NL
            if character == NL
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else
                col += 1
            position += 1
            space = true
            continue
        if character == "%"
            while position < int(#text) and text[position] != NL
                position += 1
                col += 1
            space = true
            continue
        start := position
        kind := ""
        value := ""
        number := 0
        if digit(character)
            while position < int(#text) and digit(text[position])
                position += 1
            number = int(text[start:<position])
            kind = "integer"
            if number > 2147483647
                kind = "invalid"
                value = "integer too large"
        elif lowercase(character) or uppercase(character) or character == "_"
            while position < int(#text) and alphanumeric(text[position])
                position += 1
            kind = if lowercase(character) then "name" else "variable"
            value = text[start:<position]
        elif symbols.contains(character)
            while position < int(#text) and symbols.contains(text[position])
                position += 1
            value = text[start:<position]
            kind = if value == "." and (position == int(#text) or text[position] == " " or text[position] == NL or text[position] == "%") then "end" else "name"
        elif character == "!" or character == ";"
            position += 1
            kind = "name"
            value = character
        elif ",|()[]".contains(character)
            position += 1
            kind = "punct"
            value = character
        elif character == "'"
            position += 1
            represented := ""
            incorrect := false
            while true
                if position == int(#text) or text[position] == NL
                    kind = "invalid"
                    value = "unterminated quoted atom"
                    break
                current := text[position]
                if current == "'"
                    if position + 1 < int(#text) and text[position + 1] == "'"
                        represented += "'"
                        position += 2
                    else
                        position += 1
                        kind = if incorrect then "invalid" else "quoted"
                        value = if incorrect then "undefined escape sequence" else represented
                        break
                elif current == "\"
                    position += 1
                    if position < int(#text) and text[position] != NL
                        escape := text[position]
                        if escape == "n"
                            represented += NL
                        elif escape == "t"
                            represented += HT
                        elif escape == "\" or escape == "'"
                            represented += escape
                        else
                            incorrect = true
                            represented += escape
                        position += 1
                else
                    represented += current
                    position += 1
        else
            position += 1
            kind = "invalid"
            value = "illegal character '{character}'"
        result = result.append(Token(kind, value, text[start:<position], line, col, space, number))
        col += position - start
        space = false
    return result.append(Token("eof", "", "", line, col, space))

Token peek(const ReadState state)
    return state.tokens[state.position]

Token take(ReadState &state)
    token := state.tokens[state.position]
    if token.kind != "eof"
        state.position += 1
    return token

void fail(ReadState &state, int index, message := "")
    if state.error_index >= 0
        return
    state.error_index = index
    token := state.tokens[index]
    if #message > 0
        state.message = message
    elif token.kind == "invalid"
        state.message = token.value
    elif token.kind == "eof"
        state.message = "unexpected end of file"
    elif token.kind == "end"
        state.message = "unexpected end of clause"
    elif token.kind == "name" and operation(token.value).priority > 0
        state.message = "operator priority clash"
    else
        state.message = "unexpected {DQ}{token.spelling}{DQ}"

bool punctuation(const ReadState state, string spelling)
    token := peek(state)
    return token.kind == "punct" and token.value == spelling

void expect(ReadState &state, string spelling)
    if state.error_index >= 0
        return
    index := state.position
    token := take(&state)
    if token.kind != "punct" or token.value != spelling
        fail(&state, index)

bool can_start(const ReadState state)
    token := peek(state)
    return token.kind == "integer" or token.kind == "variable" or token.kind == "quoted" or (token.kind == "punct" and (token.value == "(" or token.value == "[")) or (token.kind == "name" and (operation(token.value).priority == 0 or prefix_priority(token.value) > 0))

class Parsed(int term, int priority)
Parsed parse_term(ReadState &state, terms.Store &store, int limit);
Parsed primary(ReadState &state, terms.Store &store, int limit);

Parsed parse_term(ReadState &state, terms.Store &store, int limit)
    value := primary(&state, &store, limit)
    while state.error_index < 0
        token := peek(state)
        is_operator := (token.kind == "name" and operation(token.value).priority > 0) or (token.kind == "punct" and token.value == ",")
        if not is_operator
            break
        op := operation(token.value)
        if op.priority > limit or value.priority > op.left
            break
        take(&state)
        right := parse_term(&state, &store, op.right)
        if state.error_index >= 0
            break
        value = Parsed(terms.compound(&store, token.value, [value.term, right.term]), op.priority)
    return value

Parsed primary(ReadState &state, terms.Store &store, int limit)
    if state.error_index >= 0
        return Parsed(-1, 0)
    index := state.position
    token := take(&state)
    if token.kind == "integer"
        return Parsed(terms.integer(&store, token.number), 0)
    if token.kind == "variable"
        .state.counts.increment(token.value)
        if token.value == "_"
            return Parsed(terms.variable(&store), 0)
        match state.names.get(token.value)
            int existing
                return Parsed(existing, 0)
            none
                fresh := terms.variable(&store)
                .state.names.set(token.value, fresh)
                return Parsed(fresh, 0)
    if token.kind == "punct" and token.value == "("
        value := parse_term(&state, &store, 1200)
        expect(&state, ")")
        return Parsed(value.term, 0)
    if token.kind == "punct" and token.value == "["
        if punctuation(state, "]")
            take(&state)
            return Parsed(terms.atom(&store, "[]"), 0)
        elements := [parse_term(&state, &store, 999).term]
        while state.error_index < 0 and punctuation(state, ",")
            take(&state)
            elements = elements.append(parse_term(&state, &store, 999).term)
        tail := terms.atom(&store, "[]")
        if state.error_index < 0 and punctuation(state, "|")
            take(&state)
            tail = parse_term(&state, &store, 999).term
        expect(&state, "]")
        if state.error_index >= 0
            return Parsed(-1, 0)
        return Parsed(terms.make_list(&store, elements, tail), 0)
    if token.kind == "name" or token.kind == "quoted"
        if punctuation(state, "(") and not peek(state).space
            take(&state)
            args := [parse_term(&state, &store, 999).term]
            while state.error_index < 0 and punctuation(state, ",")
                take(&state)
                args = args.append(parse_term(&state, &store, 999).term)
            expect(&state, ")")
            if state.error_index >= 0
                return Parsed(-1, 0)
            return Parsed(terms.compound(&store, token.value, args), 0)
        if token.kind == "name" and token.value == "-" and peek(state).kind == "integer" and not peek(state).space
            return Parsed(terms.integer(&store, -take(&state).number), 0)
        priority := prefix_priority(token.value)
        if token.kind == "name" and priority > 0 and can_start(state)
            if priority > limit
                fail(&state, index, "operator priority clash")
                return Parsed(-1, 0)
            argument := parse_term(&state, &store, priority).term
            if state.error_index >= 0
                return Parsed(-1, 0)
            return Parsed(terms.compound(&store, token.value, [argument]), priority)
        return Parsed(terms.atom(&store, token.value), 0)
    fail(&state, index)
    return Parsed(-1, 0)

int clause(ReadState &state, terms.Store &store, query := false)
    state.names = map<string, int>()
    state.counts = map<string, int>()
    state.error_index = -1
    state.message = ""
    result := parse_term(&state, &store, 1200).term
    if state.error_index >= 0
        return -1
    index := state.position
    token := take(&state)
    if token.kind != "end"
        fail(&state, index)
    elif query and peek(state).kind != "eof"
        fail(&state, state.position)
    return if state.error_index < 0 then result else -1

class Node(string kind, name := "", value := 0, int[] args := [], binding := -1)
class Store()
    Node[] nodes := []
class Parts(int[] elements, int tail)

int add(Store &store, Node node)
    index := int(#store.nodes)
    store.nodes = store.nodes.append(node)
    return index

int variable(Store &store)
    return add(&store, Node("variable"))

int integer(Store &store, int value)
    return add(&store, Node("integer", value = value))

int atom(Store &store, string name)
    return add(&store, Node("atom", name))

int compound(Store &store, string name, int[] args)
    return add(&store, Node("compound", name, args = args))

int dereference(const Store store, int term)
    result := term
    while result >= 0 and store.nodes[result].kind == "variable" and store.nodes[result].binding >= 0
        result = store.nodes[result].binding
    return result

string kind(const Store store, int term)
    index := dereference(store, term)
    return if index < 0 then "absent" else store.nodes[index].kind

bool is_atom(const Store store, int term, string name)
    index := dereference(store, term)
    return index >= 0 and store.nodes[index].kind == "atom" and store.nodes[index].name == name

int arity(const Store store, int term)
    index := dereference(store, term)
    return if store.nodes[index].kind == "compound" then int(#store.nodes[index].args) else 0

string key(const Store store, int term)
    index := dereference(store, term)
    return store.nodes[index].name + "/" + string(arity(store, index))

bool indicator(const Store store, int term, string name, int count)
    index := dereference(store, term)
    return index >= 0 and (store.nodes[index].kind == "atom" or store.nodes[index].kind == "compound") and store.nodes[index].name == name and arity(store, index) == count

int indicator_term(Store &store, string name, int count)
    first := atom(&store, name)
    second := integer(&store, count)
    return compound(&store, "/", [first, second])

int term_indicator(Store &store, int term)
    index := dereference(store, term)
    name := store.nodes[index].name
    count := arity(store, index)
    return indicator_term(&store, name, count)

int make_list(Store &store, int[] elements, tail := -1)
    result := if tail < 0 then atom(&store, "[]") else tail
    position := int(#elements) - 1
    while position >= 0
        result = compound(&store, ".", [elements[position], result])
        position -= 1
    return result

Parts list_parts(const Store store, int term)
    int[] elements := []
    index := dereference(store, term)
    while indicator(store, index, ".", 2)
        elements = elements.append(store.nodes[index].args[0])
        index = dereference(store, store.nodes[index].args[1])
    return Parts(elements, index)

int copy_one(Store &store, int term, map<int, int> &variables);

int copy_one(Store &store, int term, map<int, int> &variables)
    index := dereference(store, term)
    if index < 0
        return -1
    source := store.nodes[index]
    if source.kind == "variable"
        match variables.get(index)
            int existing
                return existing
            none
                fresh := variable(&store)
                .variables.set(index, fresh)
                return fresh
    if source.kind == "compound"
        int[] args := []
        for argument := source.args[]
            args = args.append(copy_one(&store, argument, &variables))
        return compound(&store, source.name, args)
    return index

int[] copy_terms(Store &store, int[] values)
    map<int, int> variables
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        result = result.append(copy_one(&store, value, &variables))
    return result

int copy_term(Store &store, int term)
    return copy_terms(&store, [term])[0]

int[] variables_in(const Store store, int[] values)
    pending := values[::-1]
    int[] result := []
    while #pending != 0
        index := dereference(store, pending[-1])
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        if index < 0
            continue
        node := store.nodes[index]
        if node.kind == "variable"
            result = result.append(index)
        elif node.kind == "compound"
            pending = pending.concat(node.args[::-1])
    return result

bool same_kind(const Store store, int first, int second)
    left := dereference(store, first)
    right := dereference(store, second)
    a := store.nodes[left]
    b := store.nodes[right]
    if a.kind == "variable" or b.kind == "variable"
        return true
    if a.kind != b.kind
        return false
    if a.kind == "integer"
        return a.value == b.value
    if a.kind == "atom"
        return a.name == b.name
    return a.name == b.name and #a.args == #b.args

int type_error(Store &store, string category, int term)
    name := atom(&store, category)
    return compound(&store, "type_error", [name, term])

int domain_error(Store &store, string category, int term)
    name := atom(&store, category)
    return compound(&store, "domain_error", [name, term])

int named_error(Store &store, string name, string detail)
    argument := atom(&store, detail)
    return compound(&store, name, [argument])

int fresh_list(Store &store, int count)
    int[] elements := []
    for: position < count
        elements = elements.append(variable(&store))
    return make_list(&store, elements)

import terms = "./terms.qui"

class Trail()
    int[] bindings := []

void undo(terms.Store &store, Trail &trail, int mark)
    while int(#trail.bindings) > mark
        variable := trail.bindings[-1]
        store.nodes[variable].binding = -1
        trail.bindings = trail.bindings[0:<int(#trail.bindings) - 1]

bool unify(terms.Store &store, Trail &trail, int first, int second)
    int[][] pending := [[first, second]]
    while #pending != 0
        pair := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        left := terms.dereference(store, pair[0])
        right := terms.dereference(store, pair[1])
        if left == right
            continue
        terms.Node a := store.nodes[left]
        terms.Node b := store.nodes[right]
        if a.kind == "variable"
            store.nodes[left].binding = right
            trail.bindings = trail.bindings.append(left)
        elif b.kind == "variable"
            store.nodes[right].binding = left
            trail.bindings = trail.bindings.append(right)
        elif a.kind != b.kind
            return false
        elif a.kind == "integer"
            if a.value != b.value
                return false
        elif a.kind == "atom"
            if a.name != b.name
                return false
        else
            if a.name != b.name or #a.args != #b.args
                return false
            index := int(#a.args) - 1
            while index >= 0
                pending = pending.append([a.args[index], b.args[index]])
                index -= 1
    return true

bool identical(const terms.Store store, int first, int second)
    int[][] pending := [[first, second]]
    while #pending != 0
        pair := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        left := terms.dereference(store, pair[0])
        right := terms.dereference(store, pair[1])
        if left == right
            continue
        terms.Node a := store.nodes[left]
        terms.Node b := store.nodes[right]
        if a.kind == "variable" or b.kind == "variable" or a.kind != b.kind
            return false
        if a.kind == "integer"
            if a.value != b.value
                return false
        elif a.kind == "atom"
            if a.name != b.name
                return false
        else
            if a.name != b.name or #a.args != #b.args
                return false
            index := int(#a.args) - 1
            while index >= 0
                pending = pending.append([a.args[index], b.args[index]])
                index -= 1
    return true
